LESSON: MAGNETISM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 4.2: Magnetism

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Magnetism
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How are magnets used in day-to-day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. demonstrate the properties of a magnet
2. classify materials as magnetic or non- magnetic
3. identify the uses of magnets in day-to-day life
4. appreciate the applications of magnets in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Magnetism

Teach
• Observe Magnetism in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Magnetism (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Magnetism.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Magnetism.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Magnetism.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• demonstrate the properties of a magnet
• classify materials as magnetic or non- magnetic
• identify the uses of magnets in day-to-day life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Magnetism.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Magnetism: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are magnets used in day-to-day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• demonstrate the properties of a magnet
• classify materials as magnetic or non- magnetic
• identify the uses of magnets in day-to-day life
• appreciate the applications of magnets in day-to-day life

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
